The '''Karavis system''' was located in the [[Obtrexta sector/Legends|Obtrexta sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==Behind the scenes==
===Publication information===
The Karavis [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in "[[The Galaxy Dragon and crew|The ''Galaxy Dragon'' and crew]]," an article written by [[Bill Slavicsek]] and published in the [[Dragon Magazine 200|two-hundredth issue]] of the [[Dragon (magazine)|''Dragon'']] magazine in [[December]] [[1993]] for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Galaxy Dragon" /> The article is considered [[Canon|noncanonical]] with respect to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="Unlicensed">{{UnlicensedStatus}}</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' later placed the Karavis system in grid square K-4.<ref name="TEA" />

===The ''Galaxy Dragon'' and crew===
{{Unlicensedstart}}
[[File:Galaxy_Dragon.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The ''Galaxy Dragon'' was constructed in the Karavis system.]]
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the remote Karavis system contained a [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Shipyard/Legends|assembly line]] controlled by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The assembly line was used to construct the prototype [[Dragon-class Heavy Cruiser|''Dragon''-class Heavy Cruiser]] ''[[Galaxy Dragon]]''.<ref name="Galaxy Dragon">{{DragonCite|200|The Galaxy Dragon and crew|The ''Galaxy Dragon'' and crew}}</ref>

In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> while the [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]] of the Empire made preparations to entrap the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] in a [[Battle of Endor/Legends|confrontation]] in the [[Endor system/Legends|Endor system]]<ref name="Galaxy Dragon" /> of the [[Zuma sector/Legends|Zuma sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> Imperial [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Delurin]] oversaw a final test run of the ''Galaxy Dragon''. As part of the test, the [[Heavy cruiser/Legends|heavy cruiser]] [[First Battle of Miko|traveled]] from the Karavis system to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Miko]] in the [[Sorella system/Legends|Sorella system]]<ref name="Galaxy Dragon" /> of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and subjected it to an [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]] as retaliation for the planet's inhabitants, the [[Mikoan]]s, refusing to submit to Imperial governance.<ref name="Galaxy Dragon" />
{{Unlicensedend}}
